subject.title: [Bug]: Preflight compaction failure permanently locks Composer into "terminated" state

question: Which linked preflight-compaction fix should be treated as the canonical path for this issue?
rationale: Current main is still broken, but the active fixes change provider retryability/auth-error behavior and there are multiple overlapping open PRs, so automation should not pick a permanent contract alone.

options.title: Review narrowed runtime retryability
options.body: Use the timeout/429/5xx skip contract with 400/401/403 negative controls as the canonical fix and require proof before merge.

options.title: Require UI recovery too
options.body: Ask for a UI lifecycle safety net in addition to the runtime skip if maintainers want Composer recovery even for non-transient pre-run errors.

options.title: Pause candidate PRs
options.body: Hold the linked PRs until an owner writes a more explicit compaction failure policy.

recommendation.title: Review narrowed runtime retryability
recommendation.body: Use the timeout/429/5xx skip contract with 400/401/403 negative controls as the canonical fix and require proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter is asking for their guidance after prior feedback on the retryability contract.
